title: [Exclusive Headhunting] Supplement
lines: 01 EXCLUSIVE HEADHUNTING – CREMATION LAST WISH OPEN
DURATION: December 30, 2020, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Exclusive Headhunting, "Cremation Last Wish", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Exclusive Headhunting:
★★★★★★: W [Limited] / Weedy
★★★★★: Elysium
NOTE:
"Cremation Last Wish" is an Exclusive Headhunting
New Operator W can ONLY be obtained from "Cremation Last Wish" and will NOT appear in other Standard Headhunting
New Operator Weedy, Elysium will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
[HEADHUNTING DATA CONTRACT SHOP] DURATION: Dec. 30, 10:00 – Jan. 16, 03:59 (UTC -7)
[EXCLUSIVE HEADHUNTING] DETAILS:

During [Exclusive Headhunting] banners, if you do not get a 6* Operator after 50 rolls, the probability of obtaining a 6* Operator on the next roll will be increased from 2% to 4%. If you still do not roll a 6* Operator, the probability of obtaining a 6* Operator on the next roll will be further increased from 4% to 6%, and this process repeats until a maximum probability of 100%, at which point you are guaranteed to receive a 6* Operator.

The cumulative number of rolls that count towards this system will not carry over between different [Exclusive Headhunting] banners, and this number will be reset at the end of each [Limited Headhunting] banner. The increased probability of obtaining a 6* Operator will also not be applied to any subsequent [Exclusive Headhunting] banners.

During [Exclusive Headhunting] banners, you will obtain 1 [Headhunting Data Contract] for each roll you perform. You will earn 10 [Headhunting Data Contracts] from doing 10-roll headhunting. You can use [Headhunting Data Contracts] in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] to exchange from a selection of Operators.
NOTE:

Any time you obtain a 6* Operator during an [Exclusive Headhunting] banner, the next time you roll on that same [Exclusive Headhunting] banner, the probability of obtaining a 6* Operator will be reset to 2%.

Any [Headhunting Data Contracts] earned from previous [Exclusive Headhunting] banners will expire. After the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] closes, any unredeemed [Headhunting Data Contracts] will be converted into [Headhunting Parametric Models]. Each [Headhunting Data Contract] will be converted into 6 [Headhunting Parametric Models]. [Headhunting Parametric Models] have no expiration date, and can be used in the [Headhunting Parametric Model Shop] to exchange for designated items.
[EXCLUSIVE HEADHUNTING] EARTHBORN METALS SUPPLEMENT

For the players who have pulled during the previous [Exclusive Headhunting] banner "Earthborn Metals", based on the cumulative number of your rolls, you can receive [Headhunting Parametric Model] converted from corresponding ratio (1:6) via in-game mail after Dec. 30 maintenance.

For the players who have pulled during the previous [Exclusive Headhunting] banner "Earthborn Metals", you will obtain [Headhunting Data Contracts] corresponding to the number of rolls (1:1) when "Earthborn Metals" reruns. Meanwhile, this [Headhunting Data Contracts] can be used with the [Headhunting Data Contracts] obtained from "Earthborn Metals" rerun together.
